svg.title: Projected training time
svg.desc: Full-range historical training-loss curves for Nestor-100M (19,080 updates), scaled by the new same-H100 update timings: Latch 8.2 h, the authors' PyTorch 17.4 h. Both curves start near loss 11.55. These are projections, not measured full-run times for the final build.
svg.text: Projected hours = updates × measured update time. New-build learning checks: 300 updates.
